model.A3_2_spacing: gain *= STREAK_FACTORS[min(n,4)-1] with STREAK_FACTORS=[1,0.8,0.6,0.4] (n = consecutive same-concept answers incl. this one); gain *= 1.3 if concept last practiced >= 30 answers ago (or never), else 1.0
model.A3_3_quitProbability: pQuit = min(0.9, 0.08*max(0, sameConceptStreak-5) + 0.12*max(0, wrongRun-3)), checked after every answer; quit ends session, next answer starts a fresh session (run state reset)
model.A3_4_repeats: concept exhausted -> re-serve least recently seen question of that concept (adaptive); whole bank exhausted -> global least recently seen (random)
